title: A reversed/voided sale is excluded from every billed-line column (Revenue, Margin, Unit Cost, Sell Price, Sold via WO, Sold via Parts Sale, catalogue Units Sold)
custom_preconds:
1. A part with two in-window billed sales of known amounts, one of which you then reverse/void.
2. All movement and profitability columns are visible.
custom_steps:
1. Record the part's Revenue, Margin, Unit Cost, Sell Price, Margin %, Sold via WO / Sold via Parts Sale (and Units Sold for a catalogue part).
2. Reverse/void one of the two sales.
3. Reload the report and re-read every column.
custom_expected:
1. After the reversal, ALL the billed-line columns drop to reflect only the remaining sale - the reversed/voided sale is excluded from Revenue, Margin, Unit Cost, Sell Price, Margin %, Sold via WO, Sold via Parts Sale, and (for catalogue) Units Sold.
2. This netting is consistent with inventory Units Sold, which already nets reversals via the stock add-back.
3. A voided sale therefore inflates NO column.
